description.value: Lost Lake Passivhaus — formerly known as Austria House — is a public building located near Lost Lake in Whistler, BC. It is associated with the Canadian Passive House Institute as a demonstration project showcasing passive-house energy construction standards. Whether it currently operates as a cafe with public food and drink service cannot be confirmed from available evidence.
